# Company URL Finder

Find company domains, company names, and LinkedIn company-page URLs from company identifiers.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/company-url-finder/.

## Actions

- **Find Company Domain** (read-only): Find a company's official website domain using its name and two-character country code.
- **Find Company LinkedIn URL** (read-only): Find a company's LinkedIn company-page URL from either its name or bare domain.
- **Find Company Name** (read-only): Find the provider's company name associated with a bare website domain.
